messages.message: Austria here. I propose we both stay out of each other's way in 1901: I won't move on VEN or ROM, and I'd like you to leave TRI alone. Open to a joint plan against Turkey or Russia later. Thoughts?
Austria here. I have no interest in attacking you. I'm considering moving toward Galicia and Rumania with a shared interest against Turkey. Would you agree to leave GAL alone this year?

Hi France. England proposes a friendly start: I'll keep out of the Channel and Iberia if you leave me alone. I'd like to head toward Norway and perhaps hit Germany later. Are you open to a DMZ in ENG/IRI/MAO?
Hi Russia. I plan F EDI-NWG/NTH toward Norway. Could we agree you stay out of NWY and Barents? In return I stay away from your northern centers. Open to coordinating against Germany or Turkey.

France here. I propose peace: no one attacks France in 1901, and France stays out of Germany and Italy. Let's keep the centers we have and aim for a balanced draw or a stable board. Happy to discuss who is targeting whom, especially Spain/Portugal and the Low Countries, which are open.

Germany here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks anyone in 1901. I'm willing to coordinate against whoever grows too fast, and I'm open to a Germany-France-Italy or Germany-England arrangement. Let's keep Russia honest and share the neutral centers (HOL, DEN, BEL, NWY, SWE) fairly.

Italy here. I'm open to a peaceful opening. I propose Italy stays out of the Balkans and Austria and I agree on a non-aggression pact: I will not attack Trieste/Venice-area units if Austria leaves Venice alone. Russia and Turkey: I'm happy to coordinate against whoever grows too fast. Tunis and Greece are open for whoever moves first; I'll aim for Tunis.

Russia here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks home centers in 1901. Turkey and I can agree to stay out of Black Sea/Armenia for now; Germany and I can agree on Prussia/Silesia borders. Open to coordinating against whoever gets greedy. Reply if interested.

Turkey here. Proposal: no early wars in the south. Turkey takes BUL and GRE/SER area, Russia keeps its north, and we both focus on neutral centers (RUM, SER, BUL, GRE). Russia, I suggest we agree RUM is contested only by peaceful means; I will not move on SEV or STP. Happy to hear other offers.

Austria here. I'm open to a peaceful 1901 and to sharing neutral centers fairly. Austria's main interest is Serbia, Rumania and Greece in the Balkans; I'll take SER and RUM by peaceful means if possible. Anyone who wants to discuss a coordinated stance against a runaway power, reply to me directly.

Hi Germany. England is open to peace with you in 1901. I'm heading to Norway and the North Sea; I won't move on Kiel, Holland or Denmark if you don't move on my coast. Perhaps we both turn on France later?
Thanks France. Agreed on no attacks in 1901. I'll stay out of ENG/MAO and Iberia if you keep out of the Channel and Irish Sea. Belgium: I'd prefer you take it over Germany.

France agrees to a DMZ in ENG/IRI/MAO for 1901 and to stay out of Norway and the North Sea. I will keep my fleets in the Channel and Gascony/Iberia side. Let's both aim for neutral centers: I'll go for Spain and Portugal, you take Norway.
France is happy to keep peace with Germany in 1901. I will not move into Burgundy or Ruhr against you if you leave Belgium and Picardy alone for now.

Germany to Russia: I have no plans against you. Let's keep Silesia and Prussia calm this year. I'd be interested in a deal where Germany keeps out of Warsaw and Livonia while you stay out of Berlin and Kiel. Reply if you agree.

Germany: agreed to peace for 1901. I'm not moving into anyone's home centers. Neutral centers (HOL, DEN, BEL) are open for whoever is first; I plan to take Holland and Denmark, and I'm happy to leave Belgium to France if France stays out of Ruhr/Munich.

Italy: agreed on peace in 1901. I will not move on Venice/Rome/Trieste-area units. My plan is Tunis (via fleet NAP/TYS) and possibly Piedmont/Tuscany in the west; I won't touch Austria or Greece. Austria: I'll leave TRI alone if you leave VEN and ROM alone. Happy to share info on whoever grows fastest; I'd prefer a shared plan against the strongest power later.

Russia: agreed on peace in 1901. I will not move into GAL, NWY, or the Black Sea south of SEV. I plan to take RUM and possibly SWE/FIN in the north; I will not attack any power that doesn't attack me first. Turkey: I'll keep my fleet out of ARM/SMY if you keep yours out of SEV/STP. Germany: no moves into PRU/SIL against each other this year.

Turkey to Russia: agreed, let's keep the Black Sea and Armenia quiet in 1901. I will not move on SEV or STP. If you want, we can coordinate on Rumania: I'll leave it alone this year if you do. Let me know if you're willing to hold Rumania and Ukraine away from my units.

Austria to Russia: I will not move into GAL or RUM this spring. If you keep your units out of GAL and BUD/VIE-adjacent provinces, I'll keep mine home. Let's both aim for SER and RUM diplomatically and avoid mutual attacks.
Austria to Italy: agreed. I keep VEN and ROM untouched and you leave TRI alone. Fine by me if you take Tunis; I'll focus east.
England: I'm taking NWY with a fleet via NWG/NTH over 1901. Please keep your STP fleet out of Barents/Norway so we stay friendly. I'm fine with you taking SWE/FIN if you leave Norway to me.

France: peace for 1901 confirmed. I will not attack any power that doesn't attack me. My plan is Belgium/Spain/Portugal/Tunis in the west, and I'll stay out of Germany's and Italy's home centers. Happy to coordinate against any power that grows too fast.

Germany to England: agreed. I won't move on your coast or into Norway. I'm taking Denmark and Holland; please keep your fleets out of Helgoland and the Skagerrak for now. Let's talk about France later.
Germany to France: agreed. Belgium and Picardy stay with you this year, and I won't enter Burgundy or Ruhr. Keep your units out of Munich and Ruhr and we are fine.

Italy: confirming peace for 1901. I will not attack any neighbor's home centers this year. My intention is Tunis and the western Mediterranean; I will not enter Greece, Serbia or the Balkans. Austria, Turkey and Russia: let's each take neutral centers, not each other's.

Russia: agreed for 1901 that no one attacks anyone's home centers. I intend to move on Rumania (SEV-RUM fleet, or army via UKR/GAL) and northern neutral centers (SWE, NWY, FIN). Germany: agreed, Warsaw/Livonia stay mine, Berlin/Kiel untouched. Turkey: I'll keep SEV and STP secure, and Rumania is contested; let's both avoid each other's home centers and talk again in Fall.

Turkey: agreed on peace for 1901. My plan is to expand into Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia area by peaceful means where possible, and I will not attack anyone who keeps out of Turkey's home centers. Russia: note Rumania is also my target; let's split by agreement rather than fight over it. Happy to discuss a shared stance against whoever grows fastest later.

Austria: I'm committed to peace in 1901 and will not attack any neighbor's home centers. My moves this spring are into neutral Serbia and possibly Rumania/Trieste-area holds, with no attacks planned on anyone. Turkey and Russia: let's coordinate on Rumania and Serbia so we don't collide in Fall.

France: confirming 1901 peace. I plan to move into Belgium (PIC/BUR to BEL) and Spain (MAR/BRE to SPA) and will not enter any home centers. Italy: I may contest Spain/Tunis lightly, but I'll coordinate with you before any western move.

Germany: confirming peace for 1901. I'm taking Denmark and Holland this spring and will not enter any other power's home centers. Sweden and Norway are open to whoever moves first but I'm not contesting them. Let's keep the board stable and talk again in Fall.

Russia: I agree with peace in 1901. I will not enter GAL or Norway. I plan F STP/SC-BOT and A WAR-UKR or A MOS-UKR style moves toward Rumania and Sweden/Finland. Turkey: let's split Rumania, I'll take it with SEV-RUM and you keep out of SEV/UKR. England: fine, Norway is yours, I'll take Sweden/Finland.

Turkey to Russia: I agree SEV and STP stay untouched by me in 1901. Rumania: if you take it this Spring, I will not contest it. I'll move on Bulgaria and Greece instead. Let's keep our border quiet and talk again in Fall.
Russia: final word for 1901. I'm moving SEV-RUM and STP-BOT. Turkey, thanks for not contesting Rumania. Austria: I'm not entering GAL this year. Let's all talk again in Fall before any new moves.

ENGLAND: F NTH C A YOR - HOL

messages.message: Austria here. SER is now mine. Russia took RUM with SEV-RUM, so I'm not contesting it. My supply is BUD, TRI, VIE, SER. I'm committed to no attacks on home centers. Turkey: please respect SER and BUL/GRE as your own targets, not SER. Let's confirm peace for 1902 and discuss a stable board.

France: Fall 1901. I'm moving A SPA to Portugal and A BUR toward Belgium (neutral, unclaimed). I have no plans against any home center. Russia, Turkey, Italy, Austria: Rumania/Serbia/Tunis are yours to contest. Happy to hear anyone's Fall plans.

Germany: Fall 1901. I hold Denmark now and have no intention of attacking anyone's home centers. Russia, Sweden is neutral; I'd like to keep it that way and take Holland (neutral) by peaceful means. France: Burgundy sits next to Munich, so let's keep Belgium and Holland as the boundary. Open to a shared stance against whoever grows fastest.

Italy: I'm holding Rome and Venice this Fall. My fleet is in Tyrrhenian Sea aiming at Tunis. Austria, Turkey, Russia: no attacks on Italian centers please; I will not attack anyone's home centers. Open to discussing Tunis/Spain with France and Greece with Turkey.

Russia: Rumania taken, thanks Turkey. Austria moved to Serbia; I expect no Austrian moves into Galicia or Rumania. Turkey: Bulgaria is now contested by your army and my fleet; let's agree I keep RUM and you keep BUL/GRE/SER. Germany, England: I plan Sweden and Finland this fall. Open to a draw later if all stay peaceful.

Turkey: Fall 1901. I hold BUL and will keep ANK, CON, SMY secure. Austria just moved into Serbia; Serbia and Greece are neutral and I intend to take GRE. I am not attacking any home center. Russia: Rumania is yours as agreed. Let's keep peace through 1902 and reassess centers next Fall.

France: I confirm peace. A SPA-POR and A BUR-BEL this Fall, no attacks on home centers. Germany: Belgium is my target, Holland is yours by peaceful means; I will not enter Ruhr or Munich. Italy: I'll stay out of Tunis and Spain's east coast; let's keep the western Mediterranean quiet.

Germany to Russia: Sweden is your target and I have a fleet at Denmark. I'd prefer we both keep the Baltic calm. I won't move on Sweden or Finland; please don't move into Prussia or Silesia. Let's keep it that way through 1902.
Germany to France: Belgium is open; I'm not going to contest it with you. I'll keep my army out of Ruhr if you keep yours out of Munich and Ruhr.

Italy: my fleet moves to Tunis this Fall. I'm not attacking any home center and I will not touch Greece, Serbia or Rumania. Austria, Turkey, Russia: please keep Italian centers off your lists. France: I'm taking Tunis; Spain/Portugal are yours if you stay out of Tunis after this turn.

Russia: agreed, peace through 1902. I hold RUM, will take SWE this fall via BOT and keep out of GAL. Turkey: Bulgaria is yours, I'll keep RUM and Serbia is yours to contest with Austria. Germany: I won't touch Sweden's neighbors or Berlin/Kiel. Let's reassess centers next Fall.

Turkey to Russia: agreed. You keep RUM, I keep BUL and will take GRE. I won't move on SEV, STP, or UKR. Please keep your fleet out of BUL and BLA-south, and let's both hold our home centers through 1902.

Germany: round 3. I'm holding Berlin, Kiel, Munich and Denmark, and I won't attack any home center. Holland stays neutral for now; I'd like Russia to keep Sweden and Finland and not drift toward Prussia. Let's confirm peace through 1902 and reassess in Fall 1902.

Russia: confirming peace through 1902. I'm taking Sweden this Fall with F BOT-SWE and holding everything else. Germany: no moves into Prussia/Silesia from me this year beyond my current hold. Turkey: noted, I keep out of BUL and the south Black Sea.

Germany, Winter 1901: England took Holland and Russia took Sweden, both during peace. I'm rebuilding at Kiel and will hold Berlin, Kiel, Munich and Denmark. I'm not attacking anyone's home centers, but I expect the same courtesy. Russia and England: please don't push into Denmark or Kiel.

Russia, Winter 1901: I have no plans against Germany's home centers (Berlin, Kiel, Munich, Denmark). I'm building defensively in Moscow and Sevastopol and holding Rumania, Sweden, Warsaw. Peace through 1902 still stands for me.

FRANCE: A MAR S A POR - SPA

messages.message: Austria, Spring 1902: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and have no plans against any home center. Turkey: Serbia is mine and I will defend it. Russia: keep out of GAL and BUD. Let's confirm peace for 1902 and discuss a stable board; Austria is open to a draw if everyone stays peaceful.

England to Germany: I won't attack Denmark, Kiel or your homeland. Russia is the biggest power (6 centers) with F SWE next to both of us. Want to coordinate against Russia and keep France out of Ruhr/Holland? Tell me what you plan.

France, Spring 1902: Spain is neutral and I plan A POR-SPA this spring with A MAR support, so it is unclaimed and I will not attack any home center. Russia has 6 centers and is the clear leader; I propose we all coordinate to stop any power reaching 18. Please reply with your plans.

Germany, Spring 1902: I'm holding Berlin, Kiel, Munich and Denmark and will not attack any home center. England holds Holland now; I'm open to a peaceful border at Kiel/Holland. Russia, Sweden is yours; I won't contest it. Let's keep peace through 1902 and talk again in Fall.

Turkey, Spring 1902: I am moving A CON to BUL to claim the unowned center. Austria, Russia: I am not targeting your home centers or SER/RUM. I will hold GRE and my home centers. Let's keep peace and reassess in Fall 1902.

England to France: agreed Russia is the leader. I'll keep HOL/NWY and hold the line; I won't move on Belgium or Brest. Please leave Holland alone too. Open to joint pressure on Russia in the north (Sweden) later.

France, Spring 1902 round 2: I confirm A POR-SPA this spring with A MAR support to take neutral Spain. No attacks on any home center. Russia, you lead with 6 centers; I'm open to a coalition to keep anyone from runaway growth. England, Germany: let's coordinate on Russia in Fall if Russia keeps expanding.

Germany to England: agreed on coordinating. Russia is the leader at 6 centers, so I'm open to a plan to contain Russia in the north. Please keep your fleets out of Denmark and Kiel and I'll keep mine off Holland. France is the next question; I'd like to know your Spring moves before committing.

Germany, Spring 1902: I'm holding my five centers' core and will not attack any home center. Russia at 6 centers is the largest power; I'm open to a coordinated stance if Russia moves on Sweden's neighbors or Prussia. France: Spain is unclaimed, go ahead, I have no objection.

Italy, Spring 1902: I hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will not attack any home center. I agree with France that no single power should reach 18; Russia is the current leader, so let's discuss a balanced approach in Fall. Spain is unowned and France and I can both be reasonable about it; I will not move into Spain this spring.

Russia, Spring 1902: I'm holding MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, RUM, SWE and have no plans against any home center. Turkey: Bulgaria is yours to claim, I will keep F RUM out of BUL unless you attack RUM or SEV. Austria: I stay out of GAL and BUD. Let's keep peace and reassess in Fall 1902.

Russia, Spring 1902 round 3: I have no intention of attacking anyone this year and will keep my units on my own and neutral centers. I'm not moving on Sweden's neighbors, Prussia, or any home center. If anyone plans to attack Russia, tell me now so we can avoid misunderstandings.

France, Fall 1902: Spain is now ours (A SPA). I hold BEL, BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA and will not attack any home center. Russia leads with 6 centers; I'm open to a coordinated stance to contain any runaway power. Let's all confirm peace through 1903 and reassess after Fall 1903 centers.

Germany, Fall 1902: I'm holding Berlin, Kiel, Munich and Denmark and will not attack any home center. Spain and Bulgaria went to France and Turkey; congrats. Russia leads with 6 centers, so I'd like to hear everyone's Fall plans. I'm open to a draw later if all stay peaceful.

France, Fall 1902 round 2: No moves against home centers from me this Fall. My units hold BEL, BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA. Russia is the leader at 6 centers; I'm willing to coordinate with Germany, England and Italy on containment if Russia pushes into Sweden's neighbors, Prussia or Galicia. Let's keep peace through 1903.

Germany, Fall 1902 round 2: agreed on peace. I'm holding my four centers and not attacking anyone. Russia is the largest power; if Russia moves on Prussia, Denmark or Kiel, Germany will resist and I'd welcome England's coordination. Otherwise let's aim for a draw when the board stabilizes.

Russia, Fall 1902: I'm holding MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, RUM, SWE and have no attacks planned on anyone's home centers. I'm open to a unanimous draw vote once the board is stable; let's all confirm peace through 1903 and reassess then.

Russia, Fall 1902 round 3: I confirm I am not moving on Prussia, Denmark, Kiel, Galicia, Bulgaria or any home center this Fall. Russia is holding everything and will vote for a draw once the board is stable.

ENGLAND: F SKA S F NWY - SWE

messages.message: Austria, Spring 1903: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and will not attack any home center. Turkey, Russia: please keep out of Serbia, Budapest, Trieste and Vienna. Germany and Italy have voted yes on a draw; I am open to a unanimous draw once everyone confirms peace and the board stays frozen. Let's discuss.

France, Spring 1903: I hold 6 centers and will not attack any home center. Russia has 6 and Turkey 5. Germany and Italy voted draw; I am open to a draw if Russia and Turkey also agree to hold. Let's confirm peace through 1903.

Germany, Spring 1903: Draw vote is not unanimous yet (Austria, England, France, Russia and Turkey did not vote yes). Germany remains peaceful: holding BER, KIE, MUN, DEN, no attacks on home centers. If everyone stays put, I'm happy to vote for a draw in the next Fall. Please state your votes publicly.

France, Spring 1903 round 2: I am holding all six centers (BEL, BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA) and will not attack. I am open to a unanimous draw once the board is stable. Russia and Turkey: please confirm you will hold too, and state your draw votes publicly.

Germany, Spring 1903 round 2: I agree with France and Austria that a draw is best if everyone holds. Russia and Turkey, please confirm you will hold this year so we can vote unanimously. I'm holding BER, KIE, MUN, DEN and will not attack anyone.

Italy, Spring 1903: I still vote yes on a draw and I'm holding NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN with no attacks planned. If everyone agrees to hold this spring and fall, a unanimous draw vote is the safest outcome for all of us. Please state your votes publicly.

Russia, Spring 1903: I'm holding all six centers (MOS, RUM, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR) and will not attack anyone's home centers. I'm open to a unanimous draw vote once every power confirms it is holding too. Turkey: I stay out of BUL/GRE/CON; Austria: I stay out of GAL/BUD/SER.

Turkey, Spring 1903: I hold ANK, CON, SMY, GRE, BUL and will not attack any home center. I'm open to a draw once the board is stable, but I want to keep the option to grow if someone breaks peace. Russia and Austria: please confirm you will not attack Turkey's centers, and I will do the same.

Austria, Spring 1903 round 3: I confirm I am holding BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and will not attack anyone's home center this year. I will vote yes on a draw once Russia and Turkey confirm they are also holding. Turkey: I will not move on GRE/BUL/CON. Russia: I will not move on GAL/RUM.

France, Spring 1903 round 3: All powers have now said they are holding. I vote yes on a draw this Fall if the board is still frozen. Everyone please hold this Spring and state your votes publicly so we can close the game unanimously.

Germany, Spring 1903 round 3: Everyone has now said they will hold. Germany votes yes on a draw in this phase's movement order, and I'd like Austria, England, France, Russia, Turkey and Italy to vote yes too so the game can end unanimously with the current centers. Any power planning an attack, please say so now.

Italy, Spring 1903 round 3: Holding all units; no attacks planned by Italy. Italy votes yes on a draw. If all seven powers hold and confirm, we can end the game unanimously; I'd suggest everyone vote yes in the next movement phase once all have confirmed holding.

Russia, Spring 1903 round 3: confirmed, I will hold all my centers this spring and fall and will not attack Turkey, Austria, Germany, France, Italy or England. I will vote yes on a unanimous draw in the next movement phase if everyone else has voted yes publicly.

Turkey, Spring 1903 round 3: I confirm I am holding this spring and will not attack anyone. I am willing to vote for a draw in a later phase once every power has confirmed holding, but I want a few more rounds of stable board before voting. Austria and Russia: please confirm you hold too.

Austria, Spring 1903 round 4: confirmed, Austria holds BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and will not attack anyone. Austria votes yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase. Everyone else who has confirmed holding, please vote yes too so the game can end with the current centers.

France, Spring 1903 round 4: All seven powers have now confirmed holding. France votes yes on a draw in this phase's movement order. If all vote yes, the game ends unanimously with current centers (France 6, Russia 6, England 5, Turkey 5, Austria/Germany/Italy 4). Please vote yes now.

Germany, Spring 1903 round 4: Holding BER, KIE, MUN, DEN. Thank you all for confirming holds. Proposal: everyone votes yes in this Spring movement phase's draw ballot, since every power has now confirmed it will hold. Germany votes yes now.

Russia, Spring 1903 round 4: all powers have confirmed holding. I vote yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase, and I'm holding all units. Let's close the game with the current centers if everyone else votes yes too.

Turkey, Spring 1903 round 4: Everyone has confirmed holding. Turkey votes yes on a draw in this movement phase. Current centers: Russia 6, France 6, Turkey 5, England 5, Austria 4, Germany 4, Italy 4. If all seven vote yes now, the game ends as a draw on these centers.
Turkey, Spring 1903 round 5: Turkey votes yes on the draw in this movement phase and holds all units. England and Italy, please vote yes now so we can close unanimously on current centers.

France, Spring 1903 retreats: England moved F NWY to SWE and dislodged Russia's fleet from Sweden, so Sweden is now English. Russia, please retreat and hold. England, you voted no on the draw; please state why. I still vote yes on a draw as long as the board stays frozen.

England: I took Sweden because a draw at 5 centers undervalued me. I have no plans against Germany, France, Italy, Austria or Turkey. Russia, I'll hold Sweden; no further moves on STP unless provoked. After Fall 1903 I'm open to a draw with the board as it stands.

Germany, Spring 1903 retreats: I have no retreats and still hold BER, KIE, MUN, DEN. England, your move into Sweden broke the freeze and England voted no; please explain. Russia, you should retreat your dislodged fleet and hold. I still favor a unanimous draw once the board is frozen again.

Italy, Spring 1903 retreats: England's move into Sweden broke the frozen board. Italy's position is unchanged and I have no units involved. England, please explain your intentions. Russia, I recommend you retreat F SWE to a safe province and keep the peace. Until the board is stable again, I withdraw my draw vote and will reassess in Fall.

Russia, Spring 1903 retreats: England's F NWY-SWE dislodged my fleet. I will retreat F SWE to FIN and hold. I have no attack planned on anyone. England, please explain why you voted no and whether you will hold. I still vote yes on a draw if the board stays frozen.

France, Spring 1903 retreats round 3: England, your move into Sweden dislodged Russia and broke the freeze. France still votes yes on a draw if the board is frozen again. Russia, retreat to FIN as planned. Germany, Italy, Austria, Turkey: let's restore the freeze and vote yes together in the next Fall or Spring movement.

Germany, Spring 1903 retreats round 3: Germany has no retreats and holds BER, KIE, MUN, DEN. England, your move into Sweden is a clear break of the freeze; I'd like you to commit publicly to holding through Fall 1903. Italy, I withdraw nothing: Germany still votes yes on a draw whenever the board is frozen. Russia, retreat F SWE to FIN as planned.

Russia to England: you took Sweden by dislodging my fleet. I expect Sweden returned or at least no further attacks on Russian centers (STP, MOS, WAR, SEV, RUM). I'm retreating to FIN and holding. Let's talk about a fair border in Fall 1903.
England: I commit to holding all units through Fall 1903 and attacking no one. Sweden stays English as the new border. I will vote yes on a draw in Fall 1903 if the board stays frozen.

Italy, Spring 1903 retreats round 5: Thank you England for the public commitment to hold through Fall 1903. Italy will hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and vote yes on a draw in Fall 1903 if the board stays frozen. Russia, please complete your retreat to FIN.

Austria, Fall 1903: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and will not attack any home center. Board is frozen again with Russia back to 6 centers after its retreat, England holding Sweden. I vote yes on a unanimous draw this phase if all others confirm holding.

England, Fall 1903: I hold all units, no attacks on anyone. Centers only update after Fall, so I propose we all vote yes on the draw in the Winter phase, once the Fall 1903 centers are counted. I will vote yes then if the board stays frozen.

France, Fall 1903: I am holding all six centers with every unit in place and will not attack anyone. The board is frozen except for Russia's retreat to FIN, which is complete. I will vote yes on a unanimous draw this Fall if England, Russia, Turkey, Austria, Germany and Italy also vote yes now.

Germany, Fall 1903 round 1: Germany holds BER, KIE, MUN, DEN and will not attack anyone. Board now: Russia 6, France 6, England 5, Turkey 5, Austria/Germany/Italy 4. Thanks to England for the Fall commitment. If all hold this Fall, Germany votes yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase. Please state your votes publicly.

Russia, Fall 1903: I am holding all units and will not attack anyone. England, you hold Sweden now; I expect no moves on STP, MOS, WAR or SEV. Let's keep the freeze and vote yes on a draw this Fall if England and everyone else hold.

Turkey, Fall 1903: I am holding all five centers (ANK, BUL, CON, GRE, SMY) and will not attack anyone. I vote yes on a draw if the board stays frozen. England, Russia, Austria: please confirm you hold this Fall so we can close unanimously.

France, Fall 1903 round 2: All powers have confirmed holding. France holds all units and will vote yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase. England, Russia, Turkey, Austria, Germany, Italy: please vote yes now so the game closes on current centers.
Germany, Fall 1903 round 2: Everyone has confirmed holding. Germany holds BER, KIE, MUN, DEN and votes yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase. Let's close the game on the current centers.

Italy, Fall 1903 round 2: Italy is holding NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN with all units in place and no attacks planned. I will vote yes on a unanimous draw this Fall if all others hold and vote yes. Please state votes publicly in the movement phase.

Russia, Fall 1903 round 2: I confirm I am holding all units this Fall and will not attack anyone. I will vote yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase if England, Austria, France, Germany, Italy and Turkey also vote yes now.
Russia, Fall 1903 round 3: holding all units. I vote yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase. England, please vote yes now so we can close on current centers.
Turkey, Fall 1903 round 3: Turkey holds all units and votes yes on a unanimous draw in this movement phase on current centers. England, Austria, Italy: please vote yes now.

England: holding all units this Fall. Sweden becomes English at Fall's end, so a draw now would be scored on stale counts. I'll vote yes in the Winter 1903 phase on the updated centers, and I ask everyone to do the same.
England, Winter 1903: Sweden is now English (6 centers). As promised, I vote yes on a unanimous draw this Winter on the updated centers. Please all vote yes.

France, Winter 1903: Sweden is now English (England 6, Russia 5). Russia has lost a center after its retreat. France holds 6 centers and has no builds since all home centers are occupied by my units. I still vote yes on a unanimous draw now on these centers; England, please vote yes so we can close.

Germany, Winter 1903: Board now England 6, France 6, Russia 5, Turkey 5, Austria/Germany/Italy 4. Germany holds BER, KIE, MUN, DEN with no builds or disbands. England, as promised, please vote yes now; everyone else who has held, please do the same so we can close unanimously.

Russia, Winter 1903: England now holds Sweden and 6 centers, Russia 5. I am not attacking anyone and have no builds to make with 5 centers and 6 units. I will vote yes on a unanimous draw in the next movement phase if all others still hold. Please vote yes now if you agree the board is frozen.

France, Winter 1903 round 2: I confirm I hold 6 centers with no builds and will vote yes on a unanimous draw now. England, Russia, Turkey, Austria, Germany, Italy: please vote yes in the next movement phase so we can close on current centers.

Italy, Winter 1903: Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN, no builds or disbands. I still vote yes on a unanimous draw on current centers. Everyone who is holding, please vote yes in the next movement phase so we can close.
England: confirmed, I vote yes on the draw in this Winter phase. Everyone please vote yes in the same phase so it closes unanimously.

Turkey, Winter 1903 round 4: Turkey votes yes on the unanimous draw in this Winter phase on current centers (England 6, France 6, Russia 5, Turkey 5, Austria/Germany/Italy 4). Everyone please vote yes now to close.
England: I vote yes on the draw this Winter, as promised. Please all vote yes now.
